dct_description_sm: The International Circumpolar Data Platform is an initiative of three research projects located in the circumpolar region (Nunavik Inuit Health Survey 2004, Inuit Health in transition Greenland 2005-2010, and the IPY adult Inuit Health Survey 2007-2008) that aims to facilitate cross-disciplinary data inventory and sharing and ensure the sustainability and long-term accessibility of these data. Providing exports such as bank of data information, development of research questions and secondary research, and production of scientific papers are the main intent of the data platform. This platform will also permit scientific secondary research built on existing information. Its importance lies not only in the full value of investment in research in terms of quality of research outputs and in the re-use of data within and across disciplines but also in availability of data to the scientific community, populations and public institutions.
